concepts.way: misconception: an if body repeats while its condition holds
concepts.quote: x ends as 3, the if keeps adding 1 while x < 3
concepts.why: A Java if tests its condition once and runs x++ at most once, so x ends as 1, not 3.
The answer says nothing about assignment; the wrong value comes from the if misconception.
The answer does not discuss while loops, even though it treats the if as if it were one.
The answer says nothing about template notation.
